title: hieracium glaucinum subsp. horripilum
intro: Hieracium glaucinum subsp. horripilum, commonly known as Alpine Hawkweed, is a plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium glaucinum subsp. horripilum include soothing and calming effects, which may help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including flavonoids and sesquiterpenes, contribute to its medicinal properties.
